sv.title: Så dök Nvidiachefen upp i USA:s övervakning
sv.summary: Alice Huang ska ha haft kontakt med en kinesisk underrättelseofficer samtidigt som hon hade ett hemligt förhållande med Nvidias vd Jensen Huang, uppger The New York Times. USA utreder om AI-chip som hennes bolag köpte smugglades till Kina.

en.title: How Nvidia chief appeared in US surveillance
en.summary: Alice Huang is reported to have had contact with a Chinese intelligence officer while she had a secret relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times. The US is investigating whether AI chips her company bought were smuggled to China.
